result.summary: Several visual and content issues: truncated restaurant names, a broken discount badge showing '-0%', and partial category chips and cards cut off at the screen edges.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated and cut off mid-word in the Fastest near you section.
issues.suggestion: Allow text wrapping, use a shorter display name, or shrink/ellipsis the title so the full name is readable.

issues.description: Discount badge on the pizza card shows '-0%', which looks broken or like missing/zero discount data.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when discount is 0, or show a valid promo value; fix the data binding so invalid percentages are not displayed.

issues.description: Category filter chips are clipped on the right (partial chip visible), with no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add peek padding, a fade/scroll indicator, or ensure the last visible chip isn’t harshly cut off.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card is partially cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal list padding/card width so cards snap cleanly or show a clearer scroll peek.

issues.description: Bottom pizza card is heavily cropped by the viewport/tab bar, making the section feel incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate bottom content inset above the tab bar so cards aren’t flush-cut when scrolling stops.
